verdict.rationale: Bun as a package manager is not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers falls outside this product type's role, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Bun connecting to MCP servers in any way that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
